source.title: The macro /cast Disenchant /use item:244175 for disenchanting Runed Refulgent Copper Rods works - but there's a catch

quote: After that, it goes through Runed Refulgent Copper Rods in your bag as intended.
notes: Firsthand April 1 testimony that Runed Refulgent Copper Rod (244175) is a valid disenchant target. Macro initially targets EQUIPPED rod; safe-use caveat for addon action eligibility. No output item identities/counts, verified completed casts, ilvl at cast, character skill/spec, or current build; reference only, no material study.

quote: Disenchanting the thirty levelling rods returns roughly 75 Eversinging Dust
notes: Guide checked September 23, 2026, patch 12.1.0. Thirty is the proposed crafting/levelling recipe budget, not documented completed operation count; ~75 is an APPROXIMATE guide reimbursement estimate, not observed source-audited totalQuantity. Source identifies Eversinging Dust family but not output rank/item ID. Leave casts, castsWithDrop, totalQuantity, histogram, average and all empirical rates null.
